item.title: A message from Students:
item.description: The food bank is live! Please bring in food donations to your Period 1 Week 2 classes. There are prizes for classes who have the most collected by weight!

item.title: A message for all Grade 12s:
item.description: Senior sunrise is this Friday. Seniors are welcome to join us for a potluck and to watch the sunrise on Friday morning. See Olivia B for more information.
